title.narrative: Angola COVID-19 Strategic Preparedness And Response Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to prevent, detect and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19 and strengthen national systems for public health preparedness in Angola.
The project will continue supporting and strengthening Angola's national public health system to prevent and respond to disease outbreaks.
